0022600096.text: The Timberwolves come in at 1-0 after a road win, sitting third in the Northwest and half a game back and 7th in the West, while the Orlando Magic are 0-1 at home, 10th in the East, and fourth in the Southeast, one game back. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), and Orlando is missing Anthony Black (ankle, sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring, strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Minnesota lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 132-120 in Orlando on April 8, 2026.
